Hello Nicholas Weber,

Thank you for shopping with us.
This is a confirmation that your order has been placed and is on its way.
Your order number is #1437.

It contains the following items.
- 1 quantity of Werner MT-22 22 ft. Telescoping Multi-Position Ladder
- 2 quantity of Klein Tools D213-9NE High-Leverage Side-Cutting Pliers
- 1 quantity of IKEA ODGER Chair

You can find the receipt attached to this email.

Best,
Amazon Team
